content: Current Android official guidance recommends at least 48dp touch targets and purposeful accessibility descriptions; Android 14 supports nonlinear font scaling to 200% and explicitly requires testing at maximum font size. These sources validate large-text reflow, meaningful labels, and reachable controls as platform table stakes. The approved personal-use scope extends this with chart data-table equivalents, keyboard and D-pad access, focus restoration, reduced motion, and non-color status cues.
